microbit_builtin_setup.tooltip: Initialize buttons and auto-detect the built-in motion and compass sensor. Value blocks also initialize them automatically.

microbit_button_is_pressed.tooltip: Return true while the selected active-low button is pressed.

microbit_temperature.tooltip: Read the nRF processor die temperature in degrees Celsius.

microbit_acceleration.tooltip: Read an acceleration axis or total strength in milli-g.

microbit_gesture_is.tooltip: Detect a standard micro:bit orientation or shake gesture from acceleration.

microbit_magnetic_field.tooltip: Read a magnetic-field axis or total strength in microtesla.

microbit_compass_heading.tooltip: Return an uncalibrated horizontal compass heading from 0 to 359 degrees.

microbit_radio_set_group.tooltip: Set the radio group from 0 to 255. Both micro:bits must use the same group.

microbit_radio_set_power.tooltip: Set the common micro:bit radio power level from 0 to 7.

microbit_radio_send_string.tooltip: Broadcast up to 29 bytes as a micro:bit datagram.

microbit_radio_received.tooltip: Return true when a valid datagram is waiting to be read.

microbit_radio_receive_string.tooltip: Read and remove the latest received datagram, or return an empty string.

microbit_radio_rssi.tooltip: Return the RSSI of the most recently received valid datagram.
